brand.notes: EcoStar (Pakistani brand; after-sales via DWP Home). AC lines verified: wall splits incl. Crown (seen in videos), inverter/non-inverter splits, floor-standing lines — codes not line-specific. No official EcoStar AC fault table or service manual found; AYS has a remote guide but no EcoStar error page. Tag-only codes H1/H2/Lc/P1/P2/P3/Uc kept as low (existence, no meaning). Gree/Cooper&Hunter/Hayward 'EcoStar' collisions excluded. Support: 042-111-111-97 / 033-171-113-97, info@dwphome.pk. See docs/sources/ecostar.md.
